items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: I had a nice... I think it was eight weeks at the Rainbow Grill... with Joe Williams. I had the quartet behind him and that was a beautiful job.

ctx.x: You did go on one or more tours with him?

Well, I did a tour with him through the South and then, as I say, we had this steady job at the Rum Boogie. Now at the Rum Boogie I became a part of the show. I mean they had the chorus girls and Ziggy Johnson who'd staged this show, he staged all the shows. You know, they changed every three or four weeks, but he had his girls built around me doing a number and that's when Lionel Hampton wanted me but I was makin' more moeny with Tiny so I didn't leave. Arnett Cobb came in, they were workin' downtown at a…
You were doing well with Tiny and...
